final: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS FLOAT) / SUM(Milliseconds) as rate, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AlbumId), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_rate FROM album_stats) SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate, AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count, AVG(rate) - (SELECT mean_rate FROM overall_mean) as avg_above_mean FROM album_stats WHERE rate > (SELECT mean_rate FROM overall_mean)
